citations.quote: Only after Chinese archaeologists started excavating similar jades in Northeast China could it be attributed to the Hongshan culture.
There are two paper labels on the back of the jade pendant: one partial label with Chinese characters and one with the typed number "150".
Drill holes above its shoulders form two interconnected perforations for suspension

/data/description	With a bovine head and four horns, this seated figurine was a powerful ritual and shamanic symbol.
